title: OZ Zirndorf Event Store import file, format version 1
description: An import file of the OZ Zirndorf Event Store admin. It holds at most 2 MiB of JSON: the format version and the events to import, each in the write form EventInput of the public API v1 (openapi.yaml). Files contain no identifiers: every event brings its location along by name. Fields this format does not know are ignored.

formatVersion.description: Version of the import format; only 1 exists.

events.description: The events to import, at least one and at most 150.
